idea_findings.description: The candidate completely omits independent core contributions: the heuristic photon-in-an-accelerating-box model (Section II, pp. 2-4), the Rindler coordinate kinematic framework (Section III, pp. 4-5), and the massless scalar field extension demonstrating universality (Section V, pp. 8-9).
idea_findings.proposed_change: Add distinct core ideas for the heuristic photon argument, Rindler geometry properties, and the scalar field model.

idea_findings.description: Derivation unit D1 monolithically folds the entire technical apparatus of the paper—including Rindler metric transformations, Maxwell energy current divergence, boundary conditions, Gauss/Stokes theorems, and work-energy relations—into a single unit with a single nominal step.
idea_findings.proposed_change: Split D1 into separate derivation units for Rindler kinematics, Maxwell field confinement, boundary condition proofs, and scalar field extension.

idea_findings.description: The candidate excludes all appendix material (Appendices A, B, and C, pp. 9-17), which contains critical proofs regarding perfectly conducting wall boundary conditions, covariant derivative identities, and work done by external agents.
idea_findings.proposed_change: Expand scope to incorporate Appendices A through C as formal supporting derivation units.

derivation_findings.description: Derivation unit D1 omits all intermediate load-bearing equations, such as the Rindler metric (eq. 7), four-velocity components (eq. 15), energy integral formulation (eq. 24), divergence of the box current (eq. 25), and boundary flux conservation (eq. 28).
derivation_findings.proposed_correction: Add all intermediate equations and boundary lemmas as explicit steps within the derivation unit.

derivation_findings.description: Items it_d1 and it_001 are marked SUPPORTED, but the derivation of $E_{box}(0) = mc^2$ relies heavily on tensor calculus, general coordinate transformations, and spatial/spacetime integration over hypersurfaces, which cannot be reduced to simple algebra.
derivation_findings.proposed_correction: Mark compiler status as UNSUPPORTED with reason code 'integration' or 'tensor_calculus'.

notes: The candidate extraction is excessively compressed, reducing a 16-page rigorous field-theoretic derivation into a single core idea and a single step, entirely bypassing the mathematical machinery of Rindler frames and boundary conditions.
